question: #13160 at 70245c94 against main: before playback, does a marker popover opened from the keyboard keep the control bar drawn, and is everything else unchanged?

method.story: lab-mediaplayer--comment-markers; its sample video loads (5.059 s), so the three markers draw
method.device: 1280x800, scale 1, real keyboard and mouse events (Playwright, through the DevTools protocol); light and dark
method.bar: the control bar is the player's [data-visible] element; its computed opacity, visibility, translate and pointer-events, data-visible, and whether it matches :focus-within
method.loop: for the playing and pointer flows the harness sets the video element's loop property before playback, so the 5.06 s clip keeps playing
method.escape: Escape is pressed until the marker popover closes; the first Escape closes the tooltip of the popover's focused time element
method.noReplyField: the story's comment threads get no reply handler, so their popovers have no reply field; Tab moves to the popover's next control
method.step: each step waits 250 to 500 ms and two frames before its still and its record; idle waits sample the bar every frame
